protocol_type: Packet-based transaction protocol carried in 16-byte flits over NVHS differential lanes. Read / Write / Atomic transactions are packetized, CRC-protected, and replayed on error; flits are striped across the differential lane pairs of a sub-link ('brick' = 8 pairs/direction) and transmitted as NRZ (Gen1-3) or PAM4 (Gen4) at the NVHS line rate.

channels.name: NVHS TX sub-link
channels.description: Differential transmit lane pairs forming one sub-link ('brick' = 8 differential pairs per direction). NVHS signaling; NRZ (Gen1-3) / PAM4 (Gen4). Carries outbound flits.

channels.name: NVHS RX sub-link
channels.description: Differential receive lane pairs forming one sub-link. Receiver CDR recovers the embedded clock; descrambles and reassembles flits.

channels.name: REFCLK
channels.description: High-speed reference clock for the NVHS SerDes PLL on both ends.

channels.name: Link-management sideband
channels.description: Link training, lane-init, and power-state handshake signaling (implementation-defined).

transaction_classes.purpose: Request data from a peer endpoint's memory (e.g. peer GPU HBM read); returns a read-response carrying the data.
Write data to a peer endpoint's memory (e.g. peer GPU HBM write); posted or with completion depending on ordering needs.
Read-modify-write atomic operation on a remote memory location (e.g. atomic add / CAS) for multi-GPU synchronization.

flit_format.description: The fundamental flow-control unit. Transactions (headers + data) are carried in one or more 16-byte flits.
flit_format.crc: Each flit carries a CRC for error detection.
flit_format.replay: On CRC failure the receiver requests replay; the transmitter retransmits from its replay buffer.
flit_format.framing: Flits are framed and striped across the differential lane pairs of the sub-link; the NVHS PHY serializes them (NRZ Gen1-3 / PAM4 Gen4).

physical_layer_format.note: Gen4 (Hopper) raises the per-lane symbol rate via PAM4 while keeping 25 GB/s per direction per link; scrambling/encoding ensure DC balance + transition density for the receiver CDR.

reliability_protocol.recovery: Link-level replay — the receiver flags a CRC error and the transmitter retransmits the affected flit(s) from a replay buffer.
reliability_protocol.lane_management: A degraded lane in a sub-link may be deconfigured, narrowing link width and bandwidth while keeping the link up.

transaction_ordering.posted_writes: Posted writes do not return a completion; ordered within a virtual channel / traffic class.
transaction_ordering.non_posted: Reads and non-posted writes return responses/completions.
transaction_ordering.atomics: Atomic operations are ordered to provide multi-GPU synchronization semantics; NVLink-C2C adds cache-coherent ordering.

coherence_c2c.mechanism: NVLink-C2C (chip-to-chip) carries cache-coherent transactions between dies (e.g. Grace CPU + Hopper GPU), so CPU and GPU share a coherent memory view.
coherence_c2c.scope: Die-to-die / chip-to-chip coupling on a package or module.

addressing.transaction_addressing: Remote endpoint physical/virtual memory address carried in the transaction header; targets peer GPU HBM, CPU memory, or NVSwitch-routed destination.
addressing.routing: Point-to-point on a direct link; through an NVLink Switch (NVSwitch) destination ID / routing for fabric topologies.

frame_format.flit_framing: 16-byte flits carrying transaction header + data, CRC-protected, striped across the sub-link's differential lane pairs.
frame_format.ordered_sets: Link-training and lane-alignment sequences (implementation-defined) used during NVHS link bring-up and alignment.
frame_format.note: Generations 1-3 are NRZ; generation 4 (Hopper / H100) is PAM4.
